newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: WEGENER, TELEGRAAF IN SWAP DEAL.
newsitem.headline: WEGENER, TELEGRAAF IN SWAP DEAL.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wegener NV said on Thursday it expected to reach an agreement with a unit of Dutch publisher De Telegraaf on the swap of some of their door-to-door magazine activities in the Netherlands.
"The talks are advanced to such a point, that we can reasonably expect to reach an agreement," both companies said.
Under the agreement, to be effective July 1, Wegener Arcade will take over the distribution rights of several door-to-door magazines from Handelspost Beheer BV.
At the same time and on September 1, a string of activities on the same field will go from Wegener Arcade to De Telegraaf unit HHC.
No financial details of the swap were disclosed.
